from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=2)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_row=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in row)),None)
    sep_col=next((c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))),None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        obj_rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(v not in (2,bg) for v in g[r])]
        if obj_rows and max(obj_rows)+1<h: g[max(obj_rows)+1]=[8]*w
    elif sep_col is not None:
        obj_cols=[c for c in range(w) if any(g[r][c] not in (2,bg) for r in range(h))]
        if obj_cols and max(obj_cols)+1<w:
            for r in range(h): g[r][max(obj_cols)+1]=8
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=2).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
    sep_row=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in row)),None)
    sep_col=next((c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))),None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells)
        if minr>sep_row:
            dr=sep_row+1-minr; out=maxr+dr+1
        else:
            dr=sep_row-1-maxr; out=minr+dr-1
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
        shifted=[(r+dr,c) for r,c in cells]
        for r,c in shifted: g[r][c]=next(grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in cells if (rr+dr,cc)==(r,c))
        if 0<=out<h: g[out]=[8]*w
    elif sep_col is not None:
        minc=min(c for r,c in cells); maxc=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if minc>sep_col:
            dc=sep_col+1-minc; out=maxc+dc+1
        else:
            dc=sep_col-1-maxc; out=minc+dc-1
        orig=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r,c in cells]
        for r,c,_ in orig: g[r][c]=bg
        shifted=[(r,c+dc,v) for r,c,v in orig]
        for r,c,v in shifted: g[r][c]=v
        if 0<=out<w:
            for r in range(h): g[r][out]=8
    return g

program_source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(output), len(output[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in output for value in row if value != 2).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c, output[r][c]) for r in range(height) for c in range(width)
             if output[r][c] not in (2, background)]

    separator_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(output) if all(value == 2 for value in row)), None)
    separator_col = next((c for c in range(width) if all(output[r][c] == 2 for r in range(height))), None)

    if separator_row is not None:
        min_row = min(r for r, _, _ in cells)
        max_row = max(r for r, _, _ in cells)
        if min_row > separator_row:
            shift = separator_row + 1 - min_row
            marker = max_row + shift + 1
        else:
            shift = separator_row - 1 - max_row
            marker = min_row + shift - 1
        for r, c, _ in cells:
            output[r][c] = background
        for r, c, value in cells:
            output[r + shift][c] = value
        if 0 <= marker < height:
            output[marker] = [8] * width

    elif separator_col is not None:
        min_col = min(c for _, c, _ in cells)
        max_col = max(c for _, c, _ in cells)
        if min_col > separator_col:
            shift = separator_col + 1 - min_col
            marker = max_col + shift + 1
        else:
            shift = separator_col - 1 - max_col
            marker = min_col + shift - 1
        for r, c, _ in cells:
            output[r][c] = background
        for r, c, value in cells:
            output[r][c + shift] = value
        if 0 <= marker < width:
            for r in range(height):
                output[r][marker] = 8

    return output
'''
